preconditions.description: The size of the matrix N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L[i] <= R[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each pair of integers L[i] and R[i] must be valid column indices within the matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid row and column indices within the matrix.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'E' or 'O' indicating the parity of the sum.
The number of output lines must match the number of queries Q.
